instruction: You are given a post-processing template `/home/user/Desktop/lift_drag_base.py`. Complete the following self-contained legacy DOLFIN workflow: 1. Modify and generate `/home/user/Desktop/lift_drag.py`: - Build a 2.2 by 0.41 channel mesh by removing cells inside the cylinder centered at `(0.2,0.2)` with diameter `L=0.1` from a `RectangleMesh(...,110,21)` using `SubMesh` - Mark the resulting cylinder boundary with facet marker 5 - Solve steady incompressible Stokes flow in mixed P2/P1 spaces with `nu=0.001`, no-slip channel walls/cylinder, parabolic inlet of mean speed `U_mean=0.2`, and zero outlet pressure - Define `FacetNormal n` - Define surface force: `force = -p*n + nu*dot(grad(u), n)` - Compute force on the cylinder as the negative integral of this fluid-boundary traction on marker 5, obtaining `F_D` and `F_L` - Compute dimensionless coefficients: `C_D = 2*F_D/(U_mean^2 * L)` and `C_L = 2*F_L/(U_mean^2 * L)` 2. Run and save to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt`: Format: `drag_coefficient, lift_coefficient` [Software] Run your script with Python in the legacy FEniCS/DOLFIN 2019.1.0 environment (e.g. `from dolfin import *`). On this machine, run legacy FEniCS with `/home/user/miniconda3/bin/conda run --no-capture-output --prefix /home/user/miniconda3/envs/fenics-legacy python` when working on `lift_drag_base.py`.
